title: Get a product
description: Display a product name, current price, original price, and availability.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: Returns the selected seeded product fields. Unknown IDs cause a field error and product: null. The JSON below is the expected seed result, not a substituted live response.
writing: Explain opaque IDs, nullable original price, INR minor units, and availability. The response mirrors the selection, not the entire Product type.

title: Browse products with cursors
description: Retrieve a bounded catalogue page and continuation metadata.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: The first two seed products by ascending price are Desk Lamp and Canvas Backpack. totalCount is 3. Pass the returned endCursor unchanged as after to continue.
writing: first accepts 1-100. Keep filters and sorting unchanged. Cursors are opaque, scope-bound, offset-backed, and not durable snapshots.

title: List product categories
description: Find category IDs accepted by product creation and filtering.
query: query Categories { categories { id name } }
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: Returns cat_audio, cat_home, and cat_accessories after reset.
writing: Explain the relationship between category IDs and product inputs; do not confuse display names with IDs.

title: Read a cart
description: Inspect items, current product information, and the cart total.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: The seed cart is ACTIVE and empty, with total 0 INR minor units. After adding items, their data and total appear.
writing: Owner/admin access is required. Explain empty items, quantity rules, current pricing while active, and the checked-out snapshot.

title: Read an order and shipments
description: Retrieve an order snapshot and any recorded shipment.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: The seed order is DELIVERED and has one synthetic shipment. New orders are CONFIRMED and have no shipments.
writing: Explain order ownership, immutable line snapshots, canonical UTC DateTime, and the distinction between order confirmation and real fulfillment.

title: List the caller's orders
description: Page through private order records.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: The customer sees their orders; an administrator sees all orders. The seed customer has one order.
writing: Document role-specific visibility and caller-bound cursor scope. A total count is not necessarily a global business count.

title: Read the customer profile
description: Retrieve the current synthetic customer's profile.
query: query MyProfile { me { id name email } }
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: Returns cust_1001 with the customer token. Seller and administrator roles are not customer profiles.
writing: State customer-only access and distinguish this identity lookup from permission to access another customer's resources.

title: Create a product
description: Add a catalogue product with a unique SKU.

input.name: Travel Mug
input.description: Reusable mug for the learning catalogue.

prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies. Reset before repeating this exact SKU.
expected: Creates a new product owned by the seller. Reusing the SKU conflicts. Retain the returned product ID.
writing: Describe required input fields, product name/SKU limits, supported currency, integer unit-price bounds, ownership, and optional original price.

title: Update a product
description: Change supplied catalogue fields without replacing omitted values.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: Changes the name and clears the original price. Other values are preserved.
writing: Omission preserves a value. Null clears only priceBeforeMarkdown; other null inputs fail business validation. Empty updates are invalid. Requires owning seller/admin.

title: Delete a product
description: Remove a catalogue product when no active cart references it.
query: mutation DeleteProduct($id: ID!) { deleteProduct(id: $id) { deletedId } }
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: Deletes the seed lamp when not in an active cart. Repeating the deletion produces NOT_FOUND.
writing: Explain permission, active-cart dependency conflicts, historical order snapshots, and destructive/reset behavior.

title: Create an empty cart
description: Start a new purchase intent with a customer-owned cart.
query: mutation StartCart { createCart { cart { id status items { id } total { amountMinor currency } } } }
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: Returns a new ACTIVE empty cart. Save the returned ID for later operations.
writing: Each successful call creates a distinct cart. Do not hard-code a generated sequence value or claim this mutation is inherently idempotent.

title: Add a cart item
description: Add one available product not already present in an ACTIVE cart.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies. The seed cart must be empty.
expected: Adds the headphones and returns the updated cart. Save the returned item ID; a repeated add conflicts.
writing: Quantity is 1-99; maximum ten distinct products. Owner/admin access, availability, cart state, and duplicate behavior are business rules beyond SDL.

title: Replace a cart-item quantity
description: Set an existing item's quantity to a new value.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies. First run Add a cart item once after reset; use its returned item ID.
expected: Replaces quantity with 2, not an increment by 2. A closed cart cannot be edited.
writing: Explain the identifier handoff, replacement semantics, quantity bounds, ownership, and use of removeCartItem rather than zero.

title: Remove a cart item
description: Delete an item from an ACTIVE cart.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies. First add a product and use its returned item ID.
expected: Returns the updated cart after removal. Repeating with a missing item produces NOT_FOUND.
writing: Distinguish item ID from product ID. Describe ownership, ACTIVE-state requirement, and empty-cart total behavior.

title: Place an order safely
description: Snapshot a nonempty cart and retain an idempotent order result.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies. First add prod_1001 to cart_1001. Preserve this key and the exact details for retries.
expected: Creates a CONFIRMED order and closes the cart. Identical replay returns the saved order with replayed true. Changed details with the same key conflict.
writing: Document customer-only access, cart state, stock recheck, immutable prices, key scope and retention, and the absence of payments or inventory reservation.

title: Cancel a confirmed order
description: Move a CONFIRMED order to CANCELLED.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies. First add a cart item and place an order; replace id with the returned order ID. The seed delivered order cannot be cancelled.
expected: Cancels a confirmed order. An already-cancelled order returns unchanged; a delivered order produces an ORDER_STATE conflict.
writing: Explain order ownership, accepted states, repeated cancellation, optional reason, and no automatic refund behavior.

title: Submit a product review
description: Create one review per customer and product.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: Adds a review for the lamp. A second review by the same customer for that product conflicts.
writing: Rating is integer 1-5; comment is 1-2000 characters. The demo does not enforce a verified-purchase policy.

title: Request a whole-order return
description: Record a return request for a DELIVERED order.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: Creates a REQUESTED return. Only one return per order is allowed.
writing: Owner/admin access, delivered-state precondition, reason1-500, and no automatic refund or return-shipping action.

title: Intentional error: public and private fields
description: Observe usable product data alongside an authorization error.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies. Do not select a token for this example.
expected: product resolves; me is null with an error path of ["me"]. Inspect actual transport status independently.
writing: Explain partial data, nullable boundaries, local error extensions, and authentication recovery.

title: Intentional error: unknown field
description: Demonstrate document validation before business execution.
query: query InvalidField { product(id: "prod_1001") { id colour } }
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: The document is rejected because Product has no colour field.
writing: Correct the selection using the live SDL; changing the product ID does not fix a schema validation error.

title: Intentional error: variable type
description: Supply a string where the operation requires an integer.
query: query InvalidVariable($first: Int!) { products(first: $first) { totalCount } }
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: Variable coercion fails; the catalogue resolver does not interpret the word two as a number.
writing: Distinguish JSON validity, variable type compatibility, and later business-range validation.

title: Intentional error: cart ownership
description: Test authorization with a valid identity that does not own the cart.
query: query OtherCart { cart(id: "cart_1001") { id customerId } }
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: The other customer is authenticated but forbidden; cart is null with a business error.
writing: A token identifies an actor; it does not grant access to every resource.

title: Conditionally include original price
description: Use a Boolean directive to change the selected response shape.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: With false, priceBeforeMarkdown is absent from the selected response, not present with null.
writing: Explain the distinction between excluded fields and selected nullable fields.

title: Compare products using aliases
description: Retrieve two products under distinct response names.
prerequisites: Reset the local demo for the documented seed values. Start the Node server after installing the GraphQL dependencies.
expected: data.first and data.second contain their selected products.
writing: Aliases change response keys and error paths without renaming the schema field.
